description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Technomancer enters the battlefield.
In response to its trigger, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Technomancer, adding {1}.
Resolve Technomancer's trigger, milling three cards and returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Technomancer enters the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Technomancer and Karmic Guide, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 4.
